from gurobipy import GRB
import json

# Jobdaten

    "0": {"processing_time": 28, "due_date": 339, "weight": 9},
    "1": {"processing_time": 24, "due_date": 284, "weight": 5},

    "7": {"processing_time": 82, "due_date": 492, "weight": 6},
    "8": {"processing_time": 33, "due_date": 238, "weight": 4},
    "9": {"processing_time": 77, "due_date": 263, "weight": 3},
    "10": {"processing_time": 35, "due_date": 170, "weight": 6},
    "11": {"processing_time": 84, "due_date": 194, "weight": 1},
    "12": {"processing_time": 10, "due_date": 387, "weight": 7},
    "13": {"processing_time": 68, "due_date": 372, "weight": 9},
    "14": {"processing_time": 100, "due_date": 344, "weight": 10}
}

# Erstelle ein Modell
model = gp.Model("single_machine_scheduling")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Variablen
n = len(jobs)
x = model.addVars(n, n, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")
C = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="C")
T = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="T")

# Zielfunktion: Minimiere die gewichtete Summe der Verspätungen
model.setObjective(gp.quicksum(jobs[str(j)]["weight"] * T[j] for j in range(n)), GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Einschränkungen
# Jeder Job wird genau einmal eingeplant
model.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for j in range(n)) == 1 for i in range(n)), name="assign_once")
model.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[j, i] for j in range(n)) == 1 for i in range(n)), name="assigned_once")

# Berechnung der Fertigstellungszeiten
model.addConstrs((C[j] >= gp.quicksum(jobs[str(i)]["processing_time"] * x[i, j] for i in range(n)) +
                  gp.quicksum(jobs[str(i)]["processing_time"] * x[i, j-1] for i in range(n)) * (j > 0)
                  for j in range(n)), name="completion_time")

# Berechnung der Verspätungen
model.addConstrs((T[j] >= C[j] - jobs[str(j)]["due_date"] for j in range(n)), name="tardiness")

# Optimierung
model.optimize()

# Extrahiere die Lösung
sequence = [j for j in range(n) for i in range(n) if x[i, j].X > 0.5]
objective_value = model.ObjVal

# Ausgabe im JSON-Format
result = {"sequence": sequence, "objective_value": objective_value}
print(json.dumps(result))
